why_this_prompt: Among the three primary gpt-5.3-codex configurations, P1_BASELINE has the highest TI_var (0.9208 vs P4_CHECKLIST 0.9199 and P8_STRICT_B 0.8919; paper Table tab:codex_configs rounds both P1 and P4 to 0.92), the highest averaged-label human Spearman (0.466 vs 0.419 / 0.365), a 0.0 repeat flip rate, and a 0.00 bug-ladder reversal rate.
model_fallback_reason: The Codex CLI (codex-cli 0.155.1) no longer offers gpt-5.3-codex: ~/.codex/models_cache.json lists only gpt-6-astra, gpt-reserve, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5, codex-auto-review, and experiments/archive/29_proxy_validation/REPORT.md records the CLI rejecting the exact gpt-5.3-codex ID. gpt-5.6-terra is the regular-tier (non-Sol) GPT-5.6 Codex model mandated for experiment workloads by agents-config Hard Rule 8, and it is the model on which experiments/archive/29_proxy_validation already ran P1_BASELINE/P4_CHECKLIST/P8_STRICT_B property checks through the same CLI at the same effort.
reasoning_effort_reason: Identical to the exp29 CLI protocol for gpt-5.6-terra|P1_BASELINE so the existing property evidence applies to this exact configuration; the original exp16 gpt-5.3-codex calls went through the OpenAI Responses API with no explicit effort (judge_caller.py), which the CLI cannot reproduce as such.
reference_field: reference_impl = last theorem/lemma block of the gold (frozen Exp16 regex), full gold if none
repeat_aggregation_primary: mean of the 3 repeats per (item, agent), then mean over items per split (same as the Claude 3.7 table: mean over calls then items)
repeat_aggregation_secondary: median of the 3 repeats (exp16 r9_median style)
score_scale: prompt-native float in [0,1]; the Claude 3.7 table divided integer 0-10 scores by 10, so both tables are on [0,1]
cli: codex exec --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check -C <empty tmpdir> -s read-only --ephemeral --json --color never -m gpt-5.6-terra -c model_reasoning_effort="low" --output-schema score_schema.json -o <out.json> -  (prompt on stdin)
environment_scrub: every *_API_KEY variable plus ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/CLAUDE_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY removed from the child environment; ~/keys never read
authentication: ChatGPT subscription login (codex login status: 'Logged in using ChatGPT')
